name: Lightning Load Speed Optimization
author: Passionate Brains

sections.description:
This plugin will significantly boost your WordPress website’s performance by converting existing images to WebP format and enabling lazy loading.

Documentation

For Plugin documentation, please refer our plugin website.

Features

1) Convert images to WebP format with no limits or usage quotas

2) Bulk image optimization support

3) Adjustable image optimization quality

4) Resize images based on custom width and height

5) Exclude specific images based on your requirements

6) Lazy loading support for images and iframes

7) Advanced image exclusion rules

8) Custom placeholder image support during lazy loading

9) Lazy loading support for responsive images as well

Usage

To use this plugin do the following:

1) Firstly activate Plugin.

2) Go to plugin settings page.

3) Update plugin settings based on your requirements.
sections.installation:
1) Download Plugin files.

2) Login as an administrator to your WordPress Admin account. Using the “Add New” menu option under the “Plugins” section of the navigation, click the “Upload” link, find the .zip file you downloaded and then click “Install Now”. Or you can unzip and FTP upload the plugin to your plugins directory (wp-content/plugins/).

3) Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in the WordPress administration panel.
